about_the_game:
Become a legendary miner in Dwarf Digger !

As a young dwarf seeking fortune, you embark on a journey to carve out your own underground realm. Dig deep into the rocky hills, uncover rare ores, hidden treasures, and forgotten relics. But beware — the deeper you go, the greater the dangers that lurk below!

In the nearby dwarven village, trade your findings, upgrade your tools, and stock up on supplies. Venture into the surrounding forests to hunt for food and rare materials to survive. Manage your hunger and health carefully — true wealth means little if you don't live to enjoy it!

With its stylized 3D graphics and cozy fantasy atmosphere, Dwarf Digger offers an immersive blend of exploration, survival, and adventure. Will you strike gold — or dig too deep?

Key Features:

  • Dig and explore: Shape your own mine and discover valuable resources.

  • Survive and thrive: Manage food and health as you face underground threats.

  • Trade and upgrade: Sell what you find and improve your gear.

  • Stylized fantasy world: Experience a charming, hand-crafted 3D environment.

  • Hunt and gather: Venture into forests to support your survival.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Graphics: GTX 1060
  • Storage: 5 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • Storage: 10 MB available space

short_description: Dig, discover, and survive! In Dwarf Digger, you build your own underground empire, unearth precious treasures, battle hidden dangers, and trade with fellow dwarves. Will you carve your legend deep beneath the earth?
